scripts.dev: trap "printf '\n\033[33mRestart: press Arrow Up, then Enter.\033[0m\n'" INT TERM; npm run --silent build:once && npm run --silent html:css && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "Content","Site","Images","Scripts","Static","Styles","Simple CSS","Preview" -c cyan,cyan,magenta,yellow.dim,blue,green.dim,green.dim,white.dim "npm run --silent watch:site" "npm run --silent watch:templates" "npm run --silent watch:images" "npm run --silent watch:scripts" "npm run --silent watch:static" "npm run --silent css:watch" "npm run --silent html:css:watch" "npm run --silent serve" 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -v "exited with code SIGINT"
scripts.dev:verbose: npm run build:assets:dev:verbose && node build/site.js && npm run html:css:build:verbose && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "Content","Site","Images","Scripts","Static","Styles","Styles","Preview" -c cyan,cyan,magenta,yellow.dim,blue,green.dim,green.dim,white.dim "chokidar \"input/**/*.{md,html}\" -c \"node build/site.js {path}\" --ignore \"output/**\" --debounce 200" "chokidar \"templates/**\" \"build/md.js\" -c \"node build/site.js\" --debounce 200" "chokidar \"input/img/**/*.{jpg,jpeg,png,svg,gif,ico,webp,avif}\" -c \"node build/images.js && node build/site.js\" --debounce 200" "chokidar \"input/script/**/*.{js,css}\" -c \"node build/scripts.js && node build/site.js\" --debounce 200" "chokidar \"input/static/**\" \"input/_headers\" \"input/_redirects\" \"input/robots.txt\" \"input/sitemap.xml\" \"input/site.webmanifest\" -c \"node build/static.js && node build/site.js\" --ignore-initial" "node build/css.js --watch" "tailwindcss -i input/html-simple-mode/input.css -o output/html-simple-mode/output.css --watch --no-minify" "browser-sync start --server output --files \"output\" --host localhost --port 3000 --no-ui --no-notify --no-open"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:assets:prod && npm run html:css:build && node build/site.js --build
scripts.build-preview: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.dev:html: node build/site.js input/html-simple-mode/index.html --silent && npm run --silent html:css && concurrently -n "Content (html-simple-mode)","Styles (html-simple-mode)","Preview (html-simple-mode)" -c cyan,green.dim,reset "npm run --silent watch:html-simple" "npm run --silent html:css:watch" "npm run --silent serve:html"
scripts.build:html: npm run html:css:build && node build/site.js input/html-simple-mode/index.html --build
scripts.build-preview:html: npm run build:html && npm run preview:html
scripts.build:assets:dev: concurrently --raw --group --kill-others-on-fail -n "Static","Images","Scripts","Styles" -c blue,magenta,yellow.dim,green.dim "node build/static.js" "node build/images.js" "node build/scripts.js --silent" "node build/css.js --silent"
scripts.build:assets:dev:verbose: concurrently --group --kill-others-on-fail -n "Static","Images","Scripts","Styles" -c blue,magenta,yellow.dim,green.dim "node build/static.js" "node build/images.js" "node build/scripts.js" "node build/css.js"
scripts.build:assets:prod: concurrently --group --kill-others-on-fail -n "Static","Images","Scripts","Styles" -c blue,magenta,yellow.dim,green.dim "node build/static.js" "node build/images.js" "npm run build:scripts:prod" "npm run css:build"
scripts.serve: printf '\033[34;4mhttp://localhost:3000\033[0m\n' && browser-sync start --server output --files "output/**/*.html" "output/**/*.css" "output/**/*.js" --host localhost --port 3000 --no-ui --no-open --logLevel silent
scripts.watch:site: chokidar "input/**/*.{md,html}" -c "node build/site.js {path} --silent && echo \"file changed ({path}) and page updated\"" --ignore "output/**" --debounce 200 --silent
scripts.watch:html-simple: chokidar "input/html-simple-mode/index.html" -c "node build/site.js {path} --silent && echo \"file changed ({path}) and page updated\"" --ignore "output/**" --debounce 200 --silent
scripts.watch:templates: chokidar "templates/**" "build/md.js" -c "node build/site.js --silent && echo \"file changed ({path}) and site updated\"" --debounce 200 --silent
scripts.watch:images: chokidar "input/img/**/*.{jpg,jpeg,png,svg,gif,ico,webp,avif}" -c "node build/images.js && node build/site.js --silent && echo \"file changed ({path}) and site updated\"" --debounce 200 --silent
scripts.watch:scripts: chokidar "input/script/**/*.{js,css}" -c "node build/scripts.js --silent && node build/site.js --silent && echo \"file changed ({path}) and site updated\"" --debounce 200 --silent
scripts.watch:static: chokidar "input/static/**" "input/_headers" "input/_redirects" "input/robots.txt" "input/sitemap.xml" "input/site.webmanifest" -c "node build/static.js && node build/site.js --silent && echo \"file changed ({path}) and site updated\"" --ignore-initial --silent
scripts.serve:html: printf '\033[34;4mhttp://localhost:3000\033[0m\n' && browser-sync start --server output/html-simple-mode --files "input/html-simple-mode/**/*.html" "output/html-simple-mode/output.css" --host localhost --port 3000 --no-ui --no-notify --no-open --logLevel silent
scripts.html:css:watch: chokidar "input/html-simple-mode/input.css" "input/html-simple-mode/**/*.html" -c "npm run --silent html:css && echo \"file changed ({path}) and page updated\"" --ignore-initial --silent
scripts.lint: npm run build && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:links
scripts.lint:links:check: linkinator http://127.0.0.1:4000/ --recurse --check-fragments --clean-urls --redirects warn --require-https warn --format json | node lint/filter-linkinator.js
